audit.whatIsWrong: The published level chart handed Heimerdinger levels 3, 6 and 2+ items at 8/10 and gave First item to neither side, while this page's OWN whys already said 'Even now' at level 3, 'neither side cleanly wins the window' at 6, 'Gangplank takes the long game' at first item and 'Even read here' at 2+ items. Four of seven rows contradicted the prose sitting next to them, and the packet chart.
audit.why: Heimerdinger genuinely owns levels 1-5 — Parrrley cannot dive him and the nest arrives faster than a reliable keg chain — but from level 3 on the keg poke chips back at the same rate, and Sheen into Trinity Force flips the building economy outright.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 4 and 6 moved to Skill and row 5 to Gangplank in both layers, proposed as one atomic group, matching the packet chart and the mirror audit (which moved the same four rows from its side).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] called Liandry's Torment 'your spike — force fights the moment it completes'. First item is Gangplank's spike in this lane, not Heimerdinger's.
audit.why: Sheen into Trinity Force gives Gangplank crit-empowered Parrrleys that two-shot turrets. Heimerdinger's item spike does not out-pace a champion whose first item deletes his damage base.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now states the Sheen/Trinity Force spike; phases[4].why names UPGRADE!!! against a level-6 global Cannon Barrage; phases[6].why states the even 2-item read.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer 'track his cooldown' line pointed at Powder Keg. Powder Keg's cooldown in the kit file is 0 and it costs 0 mana — there is no window to punish. The real punishable cooldown was never named anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy (W) is 22/20/18/16/14s and it CURES crowd control effects and restores health — it is the direct counter to CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade's stun and to every slow Heimerdinger applies. Land hard CC while it is down or the trade is undone for free. Parrrley is point-and-click at 625 range on a 4.5s cooldown, which is what kills seeded turrets.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, winCon and tldr now name Remove Scurvy's 22s rank-1 cooldown and Parrrley's 625 range instead of a nonexistent Powder Keg timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line carried no anti-heal despite Remove Scurvy being the reason extended trades fail.
audit.why: Gangplank sustains through the exact chip damage a turret nest deals; Grievous Wounds timing decides whether beam damage sticks.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now routes second item into Morellonomicon and says why.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] 'Eat a full barrel chain' was described as 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' — a description of spending a cooldown, attached to a don't about receiving damage.
audit.why: The actual cost of a keg chain is the slow, which pins an immobile champion inside Gangplank's auto range.
audit.corrected: Description replaced with the slow-into-autos consequence.

edits.after: UPGRADE!!! adds a super-turret or a wider stun, but Cannon Barrage answers from off-screen — neither side cleanly wins 6.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen into Trinity Force gives him crit Parrrleys that two-shot your buildings — his item beats yours.

edits.after: Even read: crit and a global Cannon Barrage zone your siege, but your UPGRADE!!! turret still anchors the defensive fight.

edits.before: He barrels your turrets — spread them, E-stun him. Heimerdinger wins the Powder Kegs cooldown windows.
edits.after: Parrrley one-shots a turret from 625 range for gold — spread the nest and win levels 1-5 before his Sheen.

edits.after: Cash levels 4-5 into plates and CS before his Sheen spike — and hold hard CC for when Remove Scurvy is down.

edits.before: Gangplank wins by landing Powder Kegs, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Gangplank wins by scaling to Trinity Force crit, two-shotting turrets and shelling your siege.

edits.before: Barrels chain through clustered turrets. Spread them. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Powder Keg has no cooldown — his real timer is Remove Scurvy at 22s, cleansing your stun and slows.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Detonated kegs slow you into his autos — step out of the circle.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (turret burn), then Rylai's Crystal Scepter; boots Sorcerer's Shoes.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment, then Morellonomicon — Remove Scurvy heals through chip; boots Sorcerer's.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Use Remove Scurvy' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE. Remove Scurvy is Gangplank's real W; the flag fired on the leading verb 'Use'. No edit made. DERIVED FLAG DISPUTED: the kit file tags Cannon Barrage (R) with trueDamage, but Riot's own description for it says only 'slowing and damaging enemies' with no true-damage wording. Per the rule that the description wins over a misfiring derived flag, I did NOT write true damage onto the page, and I removed nothing that already claimed it (nothing did). The missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' entry rests on that same flag, so it was deliberately not acted on — flagging for the user rather than shipping an unverifiable claim. The content layer for this matchup was already strong and mirror-consistent; the defects were all in the full layer plus four wrong level-chart tokens in content.
